title: 第9章 这个女配有点惨（9）
slug: 恶毒女配又在作死发疯虐哭主角
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

傅司恒怒了，他不管不顾，一把抓住沈璎的手腕，“女人，你是一定要这样惹怒我吸引我的注意吗？

注意态度！我可是是为了你好！”

沈璎挣扎了下，没挣脱，这下是真的毫不犹豫的抓起不锈钢床头柜，一个用力往傅司恒的脑袋顶上砸去。

都踏马什么年代了，还一出口就是“你这样惹怒我是吸引我的注意”（阴阳怪气）。

那么古早怎么就不乖乖入土呢？

也就是她这一下，导致时空停滞，系统跳出来几乎要把头磕烂了，

【宿主，冷静，冷静……深呼吸，对！】

然后毫不犹豫，跪下来.十几个响头，【求求你了咱能不能别每个世界都搞得鸡飞狗跳？上次你把魔界入口炸了，群魔的肢体在天上乱飞了一个月啊，上上次你把缅甸那个老板绑在烟花上送上天，那个血肉……呕……

这次这个任务世界它就是普通位面，它没有灵气，建国后妖怪禁止成精。

所以，求求你了稍微……正常一点好不好？砸死他任务失败你就要滞留在这里……杀人是要坐牢的啊！！！

我不想要一个日常坐牢的宿主。】

沈璎叹息一声，手一偏，床头柜重重的砸在地上，如果是傅司恒的脑袋，那已经被开了瓢了。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Fu Siheng was angry, he ignored it and grabbed Shen Ying's wrist, "Woman, do you have to anger me like this to attract my attention?

Pay attention to your attitude!I'm doing it for your own good!"

Shen Ying struggled for a while but failed to break free. This time she really grabbed the stainless steel bedside table without hesitation and smashed it hard on Fu Siheng's head.

How old are you on horse racing, yet the first thing you say is, "You are irritating me like this to attract my attention" (yin and yang weird).

So why didn't you just go to the ground obediently in ancient times?

It was her moment that caused time and space to stagnate. The system jumped out and almost smashed her head.

[Host, calm down, calm down... take a deep breath, yes!】

Then without hesitation, he knelt down and nodded a dozen times, "Please, can we not make every world a mess?"Last time you blew up the entrance to the demon world, and the limbs of the demons flew in the sky for a month. Last time, you tied the boss of Myanmar to a firework and sent it to the sky. That flesh and blood... vomit...

This time the mission world is an ordinary plane, it has no aura, and monsters are prohibited from becoming spirits after the founding of the People's Republic of China.

So, please, please be a little... normal, please?If you fail the mission of smashing him to death, you will be stranded here... You will go to jail for killing someone!!!

I don't want a host who is in jail on a daily basis.】

Shen Ying sighed, turned her hand, and the bedside table hit the ground hard. If it was Fu Siheng's head, it would have been opened.
